reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Provision of a sovereign loan of up to EUR 30 million to the Republic of Kosovo for the benefit of the Regional Water Company Prishtina ("RWCP", the "Company" or the "Client") to finance the extension of the wastewater collection network and construction of a new wastewater treatment plan ("WWTP") in the Municipality of Podujeva (the "Project"). The Project will address critical wastewater treatment needs in Podujeva and will benefit an estimated 50,000 inhabitants. Extension of the Company's wastewater network and construction of a new WWTP in the Municipality of Podujeva to collect and treat wastewater in accordance with the relevant EU environmental standards. Significant reduction of raw wastewater volumes and its associated pollutant loads that are discharged straight into the river and local freshwater resources.
